settings.title: Frequently asked questions.

settings.content: What to expect, how the work is planned and what matters before you get started.

settings.title: SEO & local search

<button aria-controls="faq-0-0-answer" aria-expanded="true" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-0-0-question">What does an SEO engagement include?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-minus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: The scope starts with your goals and the condition of your website. A typical plan combines a technical audit, keyword and competitor research, page improvements, content priorities and measurement. The proposed deliverables are agreed before work begins.

settings.title: <button aria-controls="faq-0-1-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-0-1-question">Can you guarantee a first-place Google ranking?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: No. Search rankings depend on competition, algorithms and factors outside an agency’s control. We focus on improvements we can implement, explain the reasoning and report progress without promising a particular position.

settings.title: <button aria-controls="faq-0-2-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-0-2-question">How is local SEO different from broader SEO?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: Local SEO focuses on searches connected to a place or service area. It combines accurate Google Business Profile information, relevant location pages, consistent business details and useful local content. Broader SEO addresses demand that is not limited to one location.

settings.title: <button aria-controls="faq-0-3-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-0-3-question">Can you help with AI search visibility?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: Yes. Clear entity information, useful answers and a crawlable website support how AI search systems interpret your content. These improvements complement SEO; they do not guarantee inclusion in any generated answer.

settings.title: Websites & eCommerce

<button aria-controls="faq-1-0-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-1-0-question">Can you develop a new website and plan SEO together?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: Yes. Navigation, page structure, content requirements and technical foundations can be considered during development rather than added after launch. The scope should identify who supplies copy, media and approvals.

settings.title: <button aria-controls="faq-1-1-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-1-1-question">Do you work with existing websites?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: Yes. We review the current platform and structure before recommending improvements. Where a redesign is appropriate, important URLs and redirects need a migration plan so useful content and existing search signals are not unnecessarily lost.

settings.title: <button aria-controls="faq-1-2-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-1-2-question">What is involved in an eCommerce website project?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: Planning covers your product catalogue, categories, product information, checkout requirements and integrations. Development and SEO should make it easy for customers to compare products while keeping categories and product pages understandable to search engines.

settings.title: <button aria-controls="faq-1-3-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-1-3-question">Which platforms can you support?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: The existing SEO service covers WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Magento, Squarespace, Wix, Weebly and BigCommerce. Development requirements and platform limitations are reviewed before a specific implementation is agreed.

settings.title: Pricing & timelines

<button aria-controls="faq-2-0-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-2-0-question">How is a project priced?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: Pricing depends on the agreed scope, website size, technical condition and required services. SEO packages are available on the SEO Services page. Website development and custom engagements require a proposal based on your requirements.

settings.title: <button aria-controls="faq-2-1-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-2-1-question">How long will a website project take?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: The schedule depends on the number of pages, design approvals, content readiness and integrations. A useful project plan includes milestones and your review responsibilities. We confirm a realistic schedule after discussing the scope.

settings.title: <button aria-controls="faq-2-2-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-2-2-question">How soon should we expect SEO progress?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: There is no universal deadline. Technical changes, content work and authority improvements have different effects and depend on competition and the site’s starting point. We track agreed indicators and explain changes over time rather than promise a fixed result.

settings.title: Reporting & working together

<button aria-controls="faq-3-0-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-3-0-question">What will be included in reporting?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: Reporting should connect completed work to the goals agreed for the engagement. Depending on available access, it can include Search Console visibility, analytics traffic and conversions, technical issues and the priorities for the next stage.

settings.title: <button aria-controls="faq-3-1-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-3-1-question">What do you need from us to get started?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: Your website URL, target markets, main services or products and business goals are a useful starting point. We then agree the scope, necessary access and responsibilities. Share access through secure invitations rather than sending passwords.

settings.title: <button aria-controls="faq-3-2-answer" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 sp-faq-question" id="faq-3-2-question">Can our internal team stay involved?<svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus" fill="none" height="24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M12 5v14"></path></svg></button>

settings.content: Yes. Clear ownership makes collaboration easier. We can coordinate recommendations with your team and explain which tasks need development, content or business approval so decisions remain transparent.

settings.title: Build a stronger digital presence.

settings.content: Tell us where your business is today — and where you want to take it.
